description: This Java interface defines a contract for handling void operations on objects that implement the Voidable interface in the OpenMRS project. It specifies a handle method to set void-related attributes and is part of the API handling framework for voiding entities.

classes.name: VoidHandler
classes.description: A generic interface for handling the void operation on entities that implement Voidable, providing a method to set void status, reason, user, and date.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Sets all void attributes on the provided object, such as voided status, void reason, voiding user, and voided date.
